title: SecOps-NG Regulatory Mapping Document
description: Machine-readable crosswalk from regulatory obligations to SecOps-NG content-model artifact IDs (controls, playbooks, metrics, detections, telemetry). Files live under content/mappings/<regime>/ and group obligations by article: each file holds an `entries` list, one object per obligation atom. Mappings are structural pointers, not legal interpretation: they tell a reviewer 'this regulatory clause is exercised by these artifacts', and they let a compiler regenerate evidence packages from a regime selection.

regime.description: Regime key matching the directory name under content/mappings/.

id.description: Stable mapping identifier. Format: `<regime>:<slug>` where <regime> is the lowercase regime key (nis2, dora, cra, gdpr, iso27001, soc2) and <slug> is a short kebab-case obligation slug, typically derived from the article/section number plus a subpoint.

regulation.description: Citation block. Identifies the source instrument and the specific article/section the obligation comes from. Public-bar text only: EUR-Lex CELEX numbers and OJ references are fine, national transposition acts must be cited by name only (no commentary).

name.description: Short name (NIS2, DORA, CRA, GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2).

article.description: Article / section / annex reference verbatim from the instrument, e.g. '21(2)(a)' or 'Annex I §1.b'.

url.description: Stable URL to the cited instrument. Prefer EUR-Lex permalinks.

obligation.description: Short paraphrase of the obligation atom this entry maps. NOT a quote of regulatory text and NOT legal interpretation; one or two sentences naming what the regulated entity must do, in plain language a reviewer can sanity-check against the cited article.

status.description: Maturity of the mapping. `draft` = mapping authored, target artifacts may not all exist yet; `provisional` = target artifacts exist as stubs; `live` = every referenced artifact has shipped content.

control_refs.description: OSCAL/D3FEND control component IDs in the SecOps-NG `ctl:` namespace that implement this obligation. Compilers and reviewers join into content/controls/ via these IDs.

playbook_refs.description: CACAO playbook stable IDs in the SecOps-NG `pb:` namespace that exercise this obligation. Slugs match content/playbooks/<slug>/ directory names.

metric_refs.description: KPI / KRI catalog IDs in the SecOps-NG `kpi:` / `kri:` namespace that measure performance against this obligation.

detection_refs.description: Sigma rule pointers in the SecOps-NG `det:` namespace that produce signal relevant to this obligation. Rarely populated — most regulatory obligations are evidence/process obligations rather than detection obligations.

telemetry_refs.description: OCSF telemetry binding IDs in the SecOps-NG `tlm:` namespace that this obligation reads from.

notes.description: Optional reviewer notes — implementation guidance, scope caveats, references to ENISA / ESAs / ENISA technical guidance. Forward-public hygiene applies.
